days.title: Viking History and Quays
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Begerin
stops.detail: The first records of Viking activity in Wexford date back to 819, when the monastery of Begerin was raided.

stops.name: Keyser’s Lane
stops.detail: An example of this is Keyser's Lane, a narrow alley leading from High Street to the car park at Crescent Quay.

days.title: Town Center and Modern Developments
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Brücke im Zentrum der Stadt
stops.detail: The town of Wexford was occupied by rebels during the uprising and was the scene of a notorious massacre in which the United Irishmen executed several resident Loyalists on the bridge in the center of the town.

stops.name: Key West Centre
stops.detail: In the 1990s, parallel to the country's economic upswing, there were a number of structural developments in Wexford, such as the new construction of the Key West Centre at the harbor, the modernization of the entire quay complex and the construction of Clonard Village, a large new residential area approx. four km from the town center.
